faqs.a: Every tattoo is priced per design, not per hour. You get a fixed quote on WhatsApp once the drawing is agreed, so a slower, more careful session never costs you more.

faqs.q: Do I need a deposit to book?
faqs.a: A small deposit holds your artist and time slot. It is deducted from the final price and can be moved once if your plans change.

faqs.q: Can I send my own reference image?
faqs.a: Yes. Use the booking form or tap “Book this design” on any piece in the gallery. Your reference goes straight to our WhatsApp, and the artist adapts it to your placement.
Yes, every studio takes walk-ins when an artist is free. Booking ahead on WhatsApp guarantees your preferred artist and time.
One touch-up after healing (around 4–6 weeks) is included for every tattoo done with us.
18 years old with a valid ID. We do not tattoo minors, even with parental consent.

faqs.q: How do you keep things hygienic?
faqs.a: Single-use needles and cartridges opened in front of you, disposable barriers on every surface, and hospital-grade sterilisation between clients.

prep.title: Moisturise your skin
prep.text: Use a simple, unscented moisturiser on the area for three days before. Soft, hydrated skin takes ink more evenly.

prep.title: Eat before you come
prep.text: Have a proper meal an hour before and bring water and a snack. Low blood sugar makes long sessions harder.

prep.title: No alcohol the day before
prep.text: Alcohol thins the blood and slows healing. Skip it the day before your session and the day after.

prep.title: Stay out of the sun
prep.text: Sunburnt or peeling skin can’t be tattooed. Plan beach and surf days for after you heal.

prep.title: Wear loose clothes
prep.text: Choose clothing that gives easy access to the placement and won’t rub the fresh tattoo afterwards.

prep.title: Bring your references
prep.text: Keep your reference photos on your phone so your artist can finalise the drawing with you on the day.
